<!-- pr-reviewer: 6d8b212ac8066d231ffbc2d27d5ca0f80c2148ed -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

Read-only docs review (no build).

Verified against main:
- The three kinds and their seed defaults: feed 1200, plunge 300, stepdown 5, stepover 3, clearance 25 (`crates/app/src/operation/seed.rs`).
- The 3D Pocket strategy list matches `crates/ui/src/operations.rs:32` (Zigzag, Waterline, Adaptive, Auto, Offset rings).
- The page's finish-pattern names cover all 18 entries of `FINISH_PATTERNS` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill3d_page.rs:171-191`).
- Quoted refusals (for example "geodesic needs an open boundary", "pencil reference diameter", "Deburr rides its cone over the edge") are found on main.
- Deburr has no Passes or Lead-in tab (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/op_tabs.rs:60`).
- `Refs #1250` is the right keyword for a partial slice.

Notes (not blocking): the weight change from 5 to 6 on posting and refusals is identical to the one in the operations-2D PR, as the body says. The depth formula in the Deburr section was not checked.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
